read_scope.notes: Read the complete 22-page frozen PDF, including references and Appendices A–G, using extracted text and visual inspection of every rendered page. Visually inspected Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–10. Read frozen paper.tex, specificity_results.tex, specificity_model_table.tex, specificity_estimator_details.tex and specificity_review_appendix.tex to resolve definitions and source locations. Technical appendices were treated as optional depth when assessing the main narrative. Independently checked the PDF SHA256 with shasum and hashlib. The abstract contains 155 whitespace-delimited words. Read no other review records, previous versions, progress records or non-snapshot manuscript.

score_reasons.expression: Excellent, precise English with consistent distinctions among aligned response, total error, collection proximity and perceptual fidelity. The opening Monet–Sisley example and the three hypothetical generators in Section 4.1 make otherwise abstract prose concrete. Qualifications normally appear where their consequences matter. The explanation of why shrinking a nearly unit aligned response lowers error could state the competing effects more directly, and the closing passages repeat some result language.
score_reasons.structure: The progression from the evaluation question through controls, features, score intuition, estimation and results is coherent. Section 5.1 clearly establishes the primary findings before the retrospective pair, calibration and source diagnostics. Table 4 makes the changed source-corrected comparison visible rather than hiding it in an appendix. Detailed estimators, diagnostic controls and earlier cohorts are appropriately separated. The short Discussion partly duplicates the Results and Conclusion instead of using that space to connect the evaluation choices.
score_reasons.new_reader_understanding: The abstract is standalone within its 155-word limit. The six prompt conditions, two repeats, fixed scenes, reference target and development scaling are intelligible without repository access. Section 4.1 defines contrasts with a real lightness gap and explains the 0/1 error benchmarks before notation; Section 4.2 explicitly distinguishes the theoretical no-contrast predictor from the generic arm. Figures 1–3 and Tables 2–4 have useful reading instructions, scales and limitations. The remaining calibration trade-off is a localized opportunity for clearer intuition, not a missing account of the method.
score_reasons.engagement: The central question is consequential and immediately illustrated; Figure 1 offers a productive visual comparison, Figure 2 makes the painter pattern inspectable, and Figure 3 reveals uneven pairwise alignment. The GPT Image 2/FLUX contrast and Nano Banana 2 scene-averaging reversal give the results a discernible narrative. Interest softens at the close because the Discussion repeats the ordering results before the Conclusion summarizes them again; a more explicit synthesis of evaluation choices would give the ending greater purpose.

strengths: Sections 1 and 4.1 translate the central distinction into a Monet–Sisley example and explain why proximity, alignment and total error can disagree.
Figure 1 shows every model and all six conditions for a specified scene; its caption clearly identifies the historical images as neither model inputs nor matched compositions.
Figure 2 combines a common overview with M/S/P details, and Figure 3 pairs aligned response with error rather than inviting a single-score reading.
Section 5.1 reports the positive aligned responses alongside the unresolved no-distinction benchmark and the limited number of resolved model comparisons.
Sections 5.4–5.5 and Tables 3–4 distinguish changes in point ordering, descriptive stability and retrospective source sensitivity from confirmatory conclusions.

The limitations consistently restrict interpretation to measured digital reference contrasts, explicitly disclose AI-only source auditing and incomplete exact-pixel access, and avoid claims of perceptual validation.

findings.issue: The text identifies both aligned response and additional differences, then states that shrinking lowers error even though the aligned response is already near one. It stops just short of explicitly explaining the trade-off that resolves this apparent paradox.
findings.reader_effect: A new reader who has learned that beta = 1 matches reference strength may need to reconstruct why reducing it to roughly 0.45 can improve agreement overall.
findings.suggested_change: Replace the two sentences beginning "It contains both useful aligned response" with: "Shrinking weakens its correctly aligned component, but reduces the larger off-target component enough to lower total error." Keep the 45% multiplier and held-out fitting description. This uses fewer words and requires no new analysis.

findings.location: Section 6 opening and Section 7, page 10; paper.tex lines 320–325 and 351–357
findings.issue: The Discussion repeats the FLUX/GPT Image 2 ordering and strength observations from Section 5.4, followed shortly by another result recap in the Conclusion. The reporting recommendation is sound, but the closing structure spends more space repeating the example than synthesizing the evaluation choices.
findings.reader_effect: The ending adds less interpretive value than the results deserve, reducing momentum after the informative source-sensitivity comparison.
findings.suggested_change: Replace the repeated model comparison in the Discussion with a compact synthesis: "Any model ordering should state whether it evaluates scene-specific or scene-averaged contrasts and whether contrast magnitude is fixed or calibrated. Pairwise scores then identify which painter distinctions contribute to that ordering." Retain the detailed numerical evidence in Section 5 and the final result summary in Section 7. This fits within the existing page count.

summary: An excellent, self-contained account of a bounded digital-reference comparison. The main story and evidential hierarchy are readily understood; the figures reward inspection and the qualifications preserve claim fidelity. Only localized refinements to calibration intuition and the closing synthesis are needed. No new experiment, representation or manuscript expansion is warranted by this editorial review.
